description: Healthcare shift marketplace POC — facilities post shifts, professionals browse by qualification and book them, concurrent booking handled via SELECT...FOR UPDATE

userStories.title: Backend scaffolding for shift-api
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the NestJS backend app scaffolded with PostgreSQL connectivity so that shift data can be persisted and queried via REST.
acceptanceCriteria: Create apps/shift-api/package.json following apps/tictactoe-api/package.json patterns (NestJS 10, TypeORM, pg, class-validator, class-transformer; no langchain, redis, socket.io, postgraphile deps)
Create apps/shift-api/tsconfig.json following apps/tictactoe-api/tsconfig.json (identical)
Create apps/shift-api/nest-cli.json following apps/tictactoe-api/nest-cli.json (identical)
Create apps/shift-api/docker-compose.yml running postgres:16 on port 54323 with database shift_marketplace (no Redis)
Create apps/shift-api/.env.example with PORT=3003, POSTGRES_PORT=54323, POSTGRES_DB=shift_marketplace
Create config files: src/config/postgres.ts, src/config/typeorm.ts, src/config/entities.ts (mirror tictactoe-api patterns, defaults to port 54323, db shift_marketplace, SnakeNamingStrategy)
Create src/main.ts bootstrapping NestJS on port 3003 with CORS enabled and global ValidationPipe
Create src/app.module.ts wiring TypeORM.forRoot (import ShiftModule and BookingModule — these will be empty placeholder modules for now)
pnpm install succeeds from monorepo root
docker:up script in package.json starts PostgreSQL container successfully
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Reference apps/tictactoe-api/ for all patterns. Port 54323 for Postgres (54321 = realty-ai, 54322 = tictactoe). Create placeholder ShiftModule and BookingModule (empty modules) so app.module.ts compiles.

userStories.title: Database entities for Facility, Professional, Shift, Booking
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the 4 TypeORM entities so that the data model supports the full shift lifecycle.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/modules/shift/entities/facility.entity.ts with: id (UUID PK), name (varchar 255), type (varchar 20: nursing_home/hospital/clinic), isActive (boolean, default true), createdAt, updatedAt. OneToMany relationship to Shift
Create src/modules/shift/entities/professional.entity.ts with: id (UUID PK), name (varchar 255), qualification (varchar 10: CNA/LPN/RN), isActive (boolean, default true), createdAt, updatedAt

Create src/modules/shift/entities/shift.entity.ts with: id (UUID PK), facilityId (UUID FK), qualificationRequired (varchar 10), startTime (timestamptz), endTime (timestamptz), payRateCents (int), status (varchar 20, default 'open': open/booked/completed/cancelled), createdAt, updatedAt. ManyToOne to Facility, OneToOne to Booking. Composite indexes on [status, qualificationRequired, startTime] and [facilityId, startTime]

Create src/modules/booking/entities/booking.entity.ts with: id (UUID PK), shiftId (UUID FK, unique), professionalId (UUID FK), status (varchar 20, default 'confirmed': confirmed/completed/cancelled), bookedAt (timestamptz, default NOW()), createdAt, updatedAt. OneToOne to Shift with @JoinColumn, ManyToOne to Professional. Index on [professionalId, status]
Update src/config/entities.ts to export [Facility, Professional, Shift, Booking]
TypeORM synchronize: true auto-creates tables on startup
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Use SnakeNamingStrategy (camelCase in TS -> snake_case in DB). Export type aliases: FacilityType = 'nursing_home' | 'hospital' | 'clinic', Qualification = 'CNA' | 'LPN' | 'RN', ShiftStatus = 'open' | 'booked' | 'completed' | 'cancelled', BookingStatus = 'confirmed' | 'completed' | 'cancelled'. See docs/clipboard-health-implementation-plan.md for exact entity definitions.

userStories.title: Shift CRUD endpoints (create, list, get, list facilities, list professionals)
userStories.description: As a facility, I need REST endpoints to create shifts and list shifts/facilities/professionals so the frontend can display and manage shift data.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/modules/shift/dto/create-shift.dto.ts validating: facilityId (UUID), qualificationRequired (IsIn CNA/LPN/RN), startTime (ISO 8601), endTime (ISO 8601), payRateCents (positive integer)
Create src/modules/shift/shift.controller.ts with @Controller('api') exposing: POST /api/shifts, GET /api/shifts, GET /api/shifts/:id, GET /api/facilities, GET /api/professionals
POST /api/shifts accepts CreateShiftDto, validates facility exists, validates endTime > startTime, returns 201 with shift including facility name

GET /api/shifts supports query params: status (open/booked/all, default open), qualification (optional CNA/LPN/RN). Returns shifts with facility name and booking info (left join booking + professional)
GET /api/shifts/:id returns shift with facility + booking + professional details, 404 if not found
GET /api/facilities returns all active facilities
GET /api/professionals returns all active professionals
Create src/modules/shift/shift.service.ts with create(), findAll(), findOne(), listFacilities(), listProfessionals() methods
Update src/modules/shift/shift.module.ts with TypeOrmModule.forFeature([Facility, Professional, Shift])
Invalid inputs return 400 with descriptive error messages
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Use @Controller('api') prefix so routes are /api/shifts, /api/facilities, /api/professionals. Use query builder for findAll() to support optional filters. Left join booking and professional so response includes booking info when shift is booked. See docs/clipboard-health-implementation-plan.md for detailed service method specs.

userStories.title: Booking endpoint with pessimistic locking
userStories.description: As a professional, I need a booking endpoint that safely handles concurrent attempts so that only one professional can book a given shift.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/modules/booking/dto/book-shift.dto.ts validating: professionalId (UUID)
Create src/modules/booking/booking.controller.ts with @Controller('api/shifts') exposing: POST /api/shifts/:id/book accepting BookShiftDto

Create src/modules/booking/booking.service.ts implementing bookShift(shiftId, dto) with: QueryRunner + startTransaction(), pessimistic_write lock on shift row, validation (shift exists -> 404, shift not open -> 409 'Shift is already booked', professional not found -> 404, qualification mismatch -> 400 with descriptive message), creates Booking record, updates shift status to 'booked', commits transaction
Transaction rolls back on any error, QueryRunner released in finally block
Update src/modules/booking/booking.module.ts with TypeOrmModule.forFeature([Booking, Shift, Professional])
Returns 200 with updated shift including booking and professional details
Concurrent booking attempts: first succeeds, second gets 409
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Use DataSource.createQueryRunner() pattern from tictactoe-api GameService.makeMove(). Lock via createQueryBuilder('shift').setLock('pessimistic_write'). Qualification mismatch message format: "Professional qualification 'X' does not match required 'Y'". See docs/clipboard-health-implementation-plan.md for exact bookShift implementation.

userStories.title: Seed script for facilities and professionals
userStories.description: As a developer, I need seed data so the frontend has facilities and professionals to work with immediately.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/cli/seed.ts that seeds: 3 facilities ('Sunrise Nursing Home' nursing_home, 'Metro General Hospital' hospital, 'Downtown Clinic' clinic) and 5 professionals ('Alice Johnson' RN, 'Bob Smith' CNA, 'Carol Williams' LPN, 'David Brown' CNA, 'Eva Martinez' LPN)
Uses upsert pattern (insert on conflict update) to avoid duplicates on re-run
No shifts seeded — facilities create them through the UI
Add 'seed' script to package.json that runs the seed file via ts-node or tsx
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Use TypeORM DataSource directly (not NestJS app bootstrap) for the CLI script. Upsert by name to be idempotent. The seed script should create its own DataSource connection, run the seed, then close the connection.

userStories.title: Backend verification via curl tests
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to verify the full backend works end-to-end before building the frontend.
acceptanceCriteria: pnpm docker:up starts PostgreSQL on port 54323
pnpm dev starts backend on port 3003, tables auto-created via synchronize: true
pnpm seed inserts 3 facilities + 5 professionals without errors
curl GET http://localhost:3003/api/facilities returns 3 facilities with UUIDs
curl GET http://localhost:3003/api/professionals returns 5 professionals with UUIDs
curl POST http://localhost:3003/api/shifts with valid payload returns 201 with shift including facility name
curl GET http://localhost:3003/api/shifts returns the created shift
curl POST http://localhost:3003/api/shifts/:id/book with matching professional returns 200 with status booked
Same booking curl again returns 409 'Shift is already booked'
curl POST http://localhost:3003/api/shifts/:id/book with mismatched qualification returns 400 with qualification error
Invalid POST requests return 400 with descriptive validation errors
userStories.notes: This is a verification story — fix any issues found during testing. Run docker:up, dev, and seed before curl tests. Use actual UUIDs from seed response in subsequent curl commands.

userStories.title: Facility dashboard page
userStories.description: As a facility user, I need a dashboard to select a facility, post new shifts, and see shift statuses.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/app/facility/page.tsx as a 'use client' component
Dropdown to select a facility (populated from GET /api/facilities on mount)
Form to post a new shift: qualification required dropdown (CNA, LPN, RN), date/time inputs for start and end, pay rate input in dollars (converted to cents on submit)
Submit calls POST /api/shifts with selected facility's ID, refetches shift list on success
Shift list shows all shifts for the selected facility (fetch with status=all or appropriate filter)
Each shift row shows: qualification, time window, pay rate formatted as dollars, status badge (open = green, booked = blue), professional name if booked
Loading and error states handled
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Use Badge component for status (variant: default/green for open, secondary/blue for booked). Pay rate display: (payRateCents / 100).toFixed(2). Fetch shifts whenever selected facility changes. Form resets after successful submission.

userStories.title: Professional dashboard page
userStories.description: As a professional, I need a dashboard to browse available shifts, book them, and see my bookings.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/app/professional/page.tsx as a 'use client' component
Dropdown to select a professional (populated from GET /api/professionals on mount)
Available shifts section: shows open shifts filtered by the selected professional's qualification (GET /api/shifts?status=open&qualification=X)
Each available shift shows: facility name, time window, pay rate formatted as dollars, 'Book' button
Book button calls POST /api/shifts/:id/book with selected professional's ID
On success: refetch both available shifts and booked shifts
On 409 error: shows 'Shift is already booked' inline on that shift row
On 400 error: shows qualification mismatch message inline
'My Shifts' section: shows shifts booked by this professional (GET /api/shifts?status=booked filtered client-side by professionalId, or use a separate query)
Loading and error states handled
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Available shifts: filter by qualification on the server via query param. My Shifts: fetch booked shifts and filter client-side where booking.professionalId matches selected professional. Error messages should appear inline near the shift that failed, then auto-clear or persist until dismissed.
